title: The Last Light in Harbor Town
summary: Young neighbors organize a safe response when a storm cuts power to their harbor.

sentences.text: A strong autumn storm knocks out the electricity in Harbor Town just before evening.
sentences.chineseHint: 一场强烈的秋季风暴在傍晚前切断了港湾镇的电力。

sentences.text: Twelve-year-old Imani sees that the small lighthouse still has one battery-powered lamp.
sentences.chineseHint: 十二岁的伊玛尼发现小灯塔还有一盏电池灯。

sentences.text: Fishing boats are already inside the harbor, but several older neighbors live alone on the dark hill.
sentences.chineseHint: 渔船已进港，但几位老人独自住在黑暗的山坡上。

sentences.text: Imani and her friend Tomas make a list of homes to check, then tell an adult rescue volunteer before leaving.
sentences.chineseHint: 伊玛尼和托马斯列出要查看的住户，并在出发前告知成年救援志愿者。

sentences.text: They carry flashlights, water, and a charged radio, and they stay together on the marked path.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们带着手电、水和充好电的无线电，并始终结伴走在标记小路上。

sentences.text: At each house, they check that everyone is warm and report any need over the radio.
sentences.chineseHint: 每到一户，他们确认大家是否温暖，并通过无线电报告需求。

sentences.text: By midnight the town hall has become a bright shelter, while the last lighthouse lamp continues to guide volunteers.
sentences.chineseHint: 午夜时镇公所成为明亮的避难所，灯塔最后的灯继续引导志愿者。

vocabulary.definition: a protected place where boats stay
energy used for lights and machines
a person who helps without being paid
shown with signs or symbols
a safe place during danger
vocabulary.example: The town hall becomes a shelter.

questions.prompt: Who do Imani and Tomas tell before leaving?

title: Maya's Science Fair Promise
summary: Maya chooses honest evidence over an impressive but unsupported result.

sentences.text: Maya promises her team that their science fair project will show exactly what their experiment finds.
sentences.chineseHint: 玛雅向团队承诺，科学展项目会如实展示实验发现。

sentences.text: They test whether bean plants grow faster under blue light than under white light.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们测试豆苗在蓝光下是否比白光下长得更快。

sentences.text: After two weeks, the measurements show almost no difference between the two groups.
sentences.chineseHint: 两周后，测量结果显示两组几乎没有差异。

sentences.text: A teammate suggests removing three short blue-light plants so the graph will look exciting.
sentences.chineseHint: 一名队友建议删掉三株较矮的蓝光豆苗，让图表更精彩。

sentences.text: Maya refuses because deleting inconvenient results would make their conclusion misleading.
sentences.chineseHint: 玛雅拒绝了，因为删除不方便的结果会让结论产生误导。

sentences.text: Instead, the team explains their method, includes every measurement, and discusses what they would test next.
sentences.chineseHint: 团队改为解释方法、保留所有测量，并讨论下一步测试。

sentences.text: The judges praise their honest report and careful reasoning, even though the original idea was not supported.
sentences.chineseHint: 尽管原想法未被支持，评委仍表扬了他们诚实的报告和严谨推理。

vocabulary.definition: a test used to discover something
numbers showing size, amount, or change
a way things are not the same
causing someone to believe something untrue
careful thinking that supports a conclusion

questions.prompt: Why does Maya keep every plant result?

title: The Map Under the Floor
summary: Friends investigate an old map without damaging a historic building.

sentences.text: During repairs at the community theater, Jun and Amara notice a rolled map beneath a loose floorboard.
sentences.chineseHint: 社区剧院维修时，俊和阿玛拉在松动地板下发现一张卷起的地图。

sentences.text: They do not pull up more wood; instead, they photograph the spot and call the theater manager.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们没有继续撬木板，而是拍下位置并联系剧院经理。

sentences.text: A local historian dates the paper to 1912 and recognizes the drawing as an early plan of the neighborhood.
sentences.chineseHint: 当地历史学家认定纸张来自1912年，并看出这是街区早期规划图。

sentences.text: A dotted line on the map ends at a square marked Water, but no modern map shows a well there.
sentences.chineseHint: 地图上的虚线终止于标有“水”的方框，但现代地图没有显示水井。

sentences.text: Old newspapers reveal that the well supplied firefighters before the town built water pipes.
sentences.chineseHint: 旧报纸显示，铺设水管前，这口井曾为消防员供水。

sentences.text: Experts scan the ground and locate the covered stone well without digging through the theater floor.
sentences.chineseHint: 专家扫描地面，无需挖开剧院地板就定位了被覆盖的石井。

sentences.text: The map enters the town archive, where everyone can study it safely.
sentences.chineseHint: 地图被收入城镇档案馆，供大家安全研究。

vocabulary.definition: a long wooden piece in a floor
vocabulary.example: The map is under a floorboard.

vocabulary.definition: a person who studies history
made from a series of small marks
vocabulary.example: A dotted line crosses the map.

vocabulary.definition: provided something that was needed
a place that preserves historical records

questions.prompt: What did the old well supply?
Where is the map finally kept?

title: One Week Without Plastic
summary: A family measures which disposable plastics they can realistically replace.

sentences.text: Ravi's family decides to avoid single-use plastic for one week and record every difficult choice.
sentences.chineseHint: 拉维一家决定一周不用一次性塑料，并记录每个难题。

sentences.text: They carry cloth bags, refill water bottles, and choose loose fruit instead of wrapped fruit.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们带布袋、重复装水，并选择散装水果。

sentences.text: On Wednesday, Ravi needs medicine that comes only in a plastic package.
sentences.chineseHint: 周三，拉维需要一种只有塑料包装的药。

sentences.text: The family buys the medicine because health matters more than making a perfect challenge record.
sentences.chineseHint: 家人买了药，因为健康比完美挑战记录更重要。

sentences.text: By Sunday, they have used six plastic items instead of their usual thirty-two.
sentences.chineseHint: 到周日，他们用了六件塑料物品，而平时是三十二件。

sentences.text: They learn that careful habits reduce waste, while some packaging requires changes from shops and manufacturers.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们明白好习惯能减少垃圾，而部分包装需要商店和制造商改变。

sentences.text: The family keeps the easy habits and sends their results to the local market manager.
sentences.chineseHint: 一家人保留容易做到的习惯，并把结果发给当地市场经理。

vocabulary.definition: made to be used once and thrown away
fill a container again
material wrapped around a product
make an amount smaller
companies that make products

questions.prompt: How long is the family's challenge?
Why do they buy the medicine?
How many plastic items do they use?

title: The Debate Club Surprise
summary: Students discover that listening can strengthen an argument.

sentences.text: The debate club discusses whether the school should replace printed notices with a digital message board.
sentences.chineseHint: 辩论社讨论学校是否应以电子信息板代替纸质通知。

sentences.text: Lena supports the change because it could save paper and update information quickly.
sentences.chineseHint: 莉娜支持，因为这样能节省纸张并快速更新信息。

sentences.text: Owen disagrees because some families have limited internet access and students may miss online messages.
sentences.chineseHint: 欧文反对，因为一些家庭网络有限，学生可能错过线上消息。

sentences.text: At first, both speakers repeat their own points instead of answering each other.
sentences.chineseHint: 起初，两位发言者只重复自己的观点，没有回应对方。

sentences.text: Their coach asks each student to summarize the other side fairly before continuing.
sentences.chineseHint: 教练要求每人先公平总结对方观点再继续。

sentences.text: After listening, Lena proposes keeping one printed notice board while adding a digital board for urgent updates.
sentences.chineseHint: 听完后，莉娜建议保留一个纸质公告栏，同时用电子板发布紧急更新。

sentences.text: The club is surprised that respectful disagreement produces a practical compromise.
sentences.chineseHint: 辩论社惊讶地发现，尊重的分歧带来了实际的折中方案。

vocabulary.definition: a structured discussion of different views
take the place of something
small in amount or availability
state the main ideas briefly
an agreement where each side accepts some change

questions.prompt: Why does Lena support a digital board?

title: Signals from the Night Sky
summary: A young astronomy group separates evidence from exciting guesses.

sentences.text: At an astronomy camp, Zuri's group records a repeating radio signal while observing a distant star.
sentences.chineseHint: 天文营中，祖里的小组在观测遥远恒星时记录到重复无线电信号。

sentences.text: The pattern appears every sixteen seconds, and the students excitedly wonder whether it is a message.
sentences.chineseHint: 信号每十六秒出现一次，学生兴奋地猜想它是否是一条信息。

sentences.text: Their instructor reminds them that an interesting explanation is not the same as evidence.
sentences.chineseHint: 导师提醒他们，有趣的解释不等于证据。

sentences.text: The group compares data from another telescope and checks nearby machines that might cause interference.
sentences.chineseHint: 小组比较另一台望远镜的数据，并检查可能造成干扰的附近机器。

sentences.text: They discover that a rotating weather radar sends a pulse every sixteen seconds.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们发现旋转气象雷达每十六秒发出一次脉冲。

sentences.text: Although the signal is not from space, the students are proud that careful testing corrected their first guess.
sentences.chineseHint: 虽然信号并非来自太空，但学生为严谨测试纠正最初猜想而自豪。

sentences.text: Zuri writes that science becomes stronger when people are willing to change their minds.
sentences.chineseHint: 祖里写道，当人愿意改变想法时，科学会更强大。

vocabulary.definition: the study of space, stars, and planets
a transmitted sign carrying information
facts that support or reject an idea
unwanted effects that disturb a signal
a short burst of energy or sound

questions.prompt: How often does the signal repeat?
